message.content: According to the conversation, Adam Smith is fine with Li Hua adding decorations to the basement, provided two conditions are met. First, the decorations must be reversible, meaning that they can be easily removed or altered if necessary. Second, Adam Smith emphasized that the additions should not damage anything in the basement. This indicates that Adam is willing to allow Li Hua to enhance the space with sound-insulating pads or similar items, as long as the modifications are reversible and non-destructive.
